absences: No vendor milestone dated 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-31 found for any 1-20 MWe vendor in the table or the non-table list, other than the Radiant 2026-10-29 DOE full-power DSA approval, which the main session owns.

Radiant DOME campaign: shipped 'Campaign was targeted to finish Q3 2026' is stale. The 2026-10-29 release (fetched via a Business Wire syndication, not radiantnuclear.com) says the unit will run 60 effective full-power days over several months, then 150 h. Not written as a Type G check because the WebFetch output was a model summary, so no quote is verbatim-verified. Main session should verify against the raw release and correct the Radiant milestone if confirmed.
Penn State FRONTIER eVinci: no 2026 NRC construction-permit application found. Index only reaches the 2025 notice of intent.
Valar Ward 250: no October 2026 vendor milestone found. Utah Trust Lands lease (2026-09-17) is in the shipped notes, not checked here.
Aalo-X: no October 2026 milestone found. Aalo's $100M Series B is dated 2025-08-19, not 2026.
Deployable Energy Unity: criticality 2026-06-30 and DOME 2027 selection (2026-09-30) both predate the cutoff or are already shipped. No new dated event.
Last Energy PWR-5: DSA approval 2026-10-07 is already shipped. No later startup or readiness-review date found.
NANO KRONOS: IMPSA MSA (2026-10-21) and Hyundai MOU (2026-10-27) are shipped. Only undated article coverage after that.
BWXT BANR: Janus Fort Campbell (2026-08-26) and Belledune (2026-10-05) are shipped. No later dated milestone found.
Natura MSR-1: FLiBE salt delivery (2026-09-18) is shipped. No October milestone found.
General Atomics GA-TES: no milestone after the 2026-08-26 Janus selection. An October 6 Fort Hood site visit predates the cutoff.
Terra Innovatum SOLO (about 2 MWe class): 2026-10-22 NRC chapter release predates the cutoff and is outside this lane. The promised remaining chapters by 2026-10-30 are unconfirmed.
Blue Energy: out of scope (about 300 MWe SMRs, 1.5 GW campus). Steady Energy LDR-50: out of scope (50 MW heat-only).
Oklo, Kairos, Westinghouse AP1000 and ARC-100 are outside the 1-20 MWe scope or have no dated post-cutoff vendor milestone.
